final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format. For each entry, I extracted the service, level (upper case), message (text after service name), and the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json following the specified structure and Acme log-triage conventions.
